subject.title: docs(onboarding): finalize phase status and phase 7 decision

question: Should the onboarding plan publish CLI-side auto-doctor as the recommended Phase 7 direction while reserving gateway minimal-surface mode for explicit owner and security approval?
rationale: The PR intentionally turns an unresolved startup-policy boundary into a recommended decision memo; documentation accuracy alone cannot establish that product direction.

options.title: Approve the decision memo
options.body: Publish the recommended CLI-side auto-doctor path and keep gateway minimal-surface mode explicitly gated on separate owner and security review.

options.title: Keep Phase 7 neutral
options.body: Remove the recommendation and describe both approaches as unresolved until an owner decision is recorded elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve the decision memo
recommendation.body: Publish the recommended CLI-side auto-doctor path and keep gateway minimal-surface mode explicitly gated on separate owner and security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the directly evidenced author of the current onboarding decision memo, though final product approval should come from the accountable onboarding owner.
